text: the building preview in this route seems to have been changed, i dont see any building but its there [Image #1]
resolution: Fixed the buildings workbench preview framing bug: BuildingStage now computes bounds from the actual rotated piece dimensions, centers on the true vertical extent, derives a fresh fallback camera from the current frame, and resends native orbit whenever the frame changes. This prevents the preview from staying framed on a single wall/old piece when selecting a larger saved building like Tower-thin. Verified the buildings workbench suite and full hmsc-int bundle.
